scripts.text:
[Pet Groomer]
Hello! Do you need some Q-Pet food?
Or maybe some accessories to decorate your Q-Pet?
There is also a Q-Pet taming item!
scripts.translation:
[寵物美容師]
您好！需要購買寵物飼料嗎？
或者需要一些飾品來裝飾您的寵物？
這裡還有寵物馴服道具哦！

scripts.text:
[Pet Groomer]
Okay, please buy it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[寵物美容師]
好的，請您自己購買吧。

[寵物美容師]
好的，那我們進行交換吧。

scripts.text:
[Pet Groomer]
Okay, come back whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[寵物美容師]
好的，您隨時都可以回來。
